name: Behringer X32 / Midas M32
notes: All 104 actions of src/actions/*.ts (the ActionsSchema types in each file list the same ids) and all 56 feedbacks of src/feedback.ts are catalogued. Feedbacks are all of type boolean.

The module controls X32 and M32 consoles over OSC (UDP port 10023). Channel, bus, matrix, DCA and main targets are dropdowns whose ids are references such as channel1, aux1, fx1, bus1, matrix1, stereo, mono, dca1 (defaultRef in src/paths.ts). They are not enumerated per channel as separate actions: one action takes the target as an option. The labels show the console names when the module has read them; the catalog records the default names.

Target dropdowns have allowInvalidValues: the module parses loose spellings (for example ch1, mix1, st, mo) through parseRefToPaths (src/paths.ts:61-140), so any string that parses is accepted. The catalog lists only the canonical ids; lists longer than 40 entries are described in choicesNote.

Dropdowns built with convertChoices default to the first choice. Pan, level and delta options come from the shared definitions in src/choices.ts (FaderLevelChoice, PanningChoice, FaderLevelDeltaChoice, PanningDelta, FadeDurationChoice); the fade curve and type are shared by all fading actions.

The mute action choice ids are numbers (2 = toggle, 0 = mute, 1 = unmute); mute groups use 1 = mute, 0 = unmute (CHOICES_MUTE_GROUP). On/off dropdowns use 2 = toggle, 1 = on, 0 = off (CHOICES_ON_OFF).
Lists that depend on the console state at runtime (preset names for the preset actions) keep their numeric ids 1..100; the preset names appear only in labels.

Several actions apply to specific console variants only (channel-bank-full and group-bank-full for X32/M32, the compact variants for X32 Compact, X32 Producer and M32R); the module registers all of them regardless of the connected model.
Built on @companion-module/base ~2.0.4: expressions are supported for option values, except on options with disableAutoExpression.
Not catalogued: variables and presets of the module.
